question: How to Resolve Transfer Issues to Wrong Beneficiary Account
answer: GTConnect; For erroneous transfers to GTBank accounts; Please note that reversal of erroneous transfers can only be done on a best-effort basis. The bank is unable to debit the customer's account without the appropriate authority to do so.; Dial +2348039003900, +2348029002900 to speak with an agent; Provide the Call Center agent with details of the erroneous transfer (i.e. amount, account name/number, transaction date, and time); The Call Center agent verifies the details provided and blocks the funds for a period of 2 weeks only.; If the beneficiary is known to you;; Please contact the beneficiary of the funds to refund the amount directly to your account or; Ask the beneficiary to provide the bank with a duly signed instruction, authorizing the bank to reverse the transaction.; If you are unable to contact the beneficiary, please note that you will be required to provide a court order authorizing the bank to reverse the transaction as well as a duly signed indemnity form.; Upon receipt of your court Order/indemnity form by the Call Center agent, the transaction will be reversed and your account credited.; Note: The beneficiary account can only be blocked for a period of two weeks.; For erroneous transfers to other banks; Dial +2348039003900, +2348029002900 to speak with an agent; Provide the Call Center agent with details of the erroneous transfer (i.e. Bank name amount, account name/number, transaction date, and time). The bank will contact the beneficiary's bank to confirm the requirements necessary for the reversal of the transaction and inform you of the same.

question: What is the GTBanks' NRN service?
answer: The Non Resident Nigerian service offering is a platform for Nigerians who reside outside the country to have access to the wide range of products and services the Bank presently offers

question: What documents are required to open an NRN account?
answer: You will need the following documents to apply for an NRN account:; a. Duly completed NRN Account Opening Form; b. Your passport photo with full face forward; c. A copy of any of the following means of Identification:; Valid Nigerian International passport with your National Identification Number (NIN) captured on it; National ID; Visit NIMC (See https://nimc.gov.ng/nimc-enrol... for list of enrolment centres); d. Copy of any of the following as a proof of address:; Notarized utility bill, OR; Stamped bank statement issued within three months showing customer's foreign address, OR; Notarized lease of agreement showing customer's foreign address, OR; Notarized tax bill issued within the last 1 year showing customer's foreign address, OR; Notarized valid foreign I.D that has the customer's names and foreign address (separate from the ID provided as means of I.D verification), OR; Notarized foreign driver's license showing customer's foreign address, OR; Notarized tenancy agreement/rent receipt, OR; Notarized letter from Multinational, Oil and Gas, Energy companies.; e. Reference (either (i) or (ii) below) – For Current and/or Domiciliary accounts.; (i) Two completed reference forms from Current account holders (Nigerian) with any Nigerian Bank. (ii) One reference letter obtained from a current banker/Banker’s confirmation and one reference letter obtained from a current account holder (Nigerian) with any Nigerian bank; f. For Joint accounts, a copy of your marriage certificate is required.; PS: Documents that require notarization can be certified as a true copy of the original by a Notary Public or a Lawyer or by the Nigerian embassy or a Post Office or a GTBank Subsidiary staff

question: What electronic channels and services are available to NRN customers
answer: The following electronic channels are available to the NRN customer:; i. Card services:; • MasterCard (USD and Naira denominated); • Visa Card (USD denominated); ii. GTWorld App; iii. NRN Support Group which is open for business 24 hours a day, seven days a week (Including public holidays); The NRN Support Group offers the following services:; • Account update; • Pre-registered transfer requests; • Proxy pick-up of cards; • Courier delivery of cards; • Reactivate dormant accounts; • Video Banking services; iv. Internet Banking:; The NRN customer with an internet banking password can do the following via the GTBank Internet Banking platform; • View real time account balances and track up-to-the minute transactions on their accounts; • Set up a standing order instruction to transfer funds to other accounts within GTBank and other Banks in Nigeria (Direct debit).; • Transfer funds to beneficiaries with GTBank accounts or accounts in other banks via NEFT; • Confirm cheques online and such confirmations are automatically registered on the Banking Application; • Request for cheque books; • Print Statement of account in PDF format or export to MS Excel format; • PIN change: Users can change their login PIN (password) at any time; * All identification documents, Bank or Credit Card statement issued within the last three-months, and utility bills (if foreign) must be notarized by a notary public, sighted at the Nigerian Embassy or by an officer at GTBank

question: Do NRN customers who have an account with GTBank UK require references to open an NRN account?
answer: No, NRNs who have current accounts with GTBank UK do not require References to open NRN accounts.

question: Do NRN customers who visit the country still have to notarize their documents?
answer: No, they do not. Sighted copies of these documents by a GTBank staff is acceptable

question: What is the role of the banker's confirmation in the NRN aacount opening process?
answer: A stamped Banker’s confirmation stating the customer’s address serves as a proof of address and a reference at the same time. Therefore, customers who provide this will not need to provide a reference or utility bill.

question: Can Corporate accounts be opened for Non Resident Nigerians under the NRN service platform?
answer: No, the NRN service is offered only to individuals and not to businesses. The customer will however be referred to the SME team.

question: Can NRN customers who reside in London submit their account opening package in GTBank UK
answer: Yes, these customers can visit GTBank UK for the submission of their NRN account opening package. They can also have their documents sighted by a GTBank UK officer in our London office.

question: How can NRN customers fund their accounts?
answer: Transferring funds directly from their foreign Bank account into their GTBank Domiciliary account.; Paying in Cheques and cash into their GTBank Naira account and cash (foreign currency) into their GTBank Domiciliary account in any GTBank Branch in Nigeria.

question: What are the services available to an NRN customer on this platform?
answer: An NRN customer can access the following products and services: • Domiciliary account (available in Dollars, Pound sterling and Euro) • GTMax account (Naira) • Savings account (Naira) • Investments • Fixed deposit ( USD, Pounds and Naira)

question: Can NRN customers lodge cheques and dividend warrants into their NRN accounts?
answer: Yes, local cheques and dividend warrants can be lodged into the customer’s account through any of the bank branches in Nigeria

question: Who are the target customers for the NRN service offering?
answer: All Nigerians who reside outside the country for more than 180 days in a year.

question: How do I get the Internet Banking Service?
answer: The Internet Banking Service is profiled to every new account opened, however, please consult with an NRN Support agent for assistance.

question: How do I get my login details?
answer: The username and password are system generated for confidentiality and sent to your registered e-mail address with the bank; please ensure your e-mail address is correctly profiled on your account. You will also be prompted to set a secret question and answer. You may contact the Bank on +234 201 448 1300, +234 201 448 1400, +234 813 985 6001, +234 813 985 6002 if you do not receive the notification sent you.

question: How do I update/reactivate my account?
answer: • Fill the NRN update/reactivation form.; • Provide a recent notarized utility bill or stamped bank statement (issued within the last 3 months) showing your address abroad.; • You can notarize seamlessly at www.notarycam.com/gtbank. You may also choose to notarize with a lawyer, court, post-office or the Nigerian embassy.; • Provide the data page of any of your Nigerian Regulatory issued ID (International passport that captured your NIN, or National ID); • Banker’s confirmation/Reference letter issued from your foreign bank; • A recent communique on "EU General Data Protection Regulation" requires that you fill our data consent form. This form is to be completed by residents in Europe while the bank files for future purpose and in line with EU General Data Protection Regulation.; • All documents alongside the form should be sent to nrnaccount@gtbank.com

question: How do I request to have my card couriered?
answer: • Fill the Account collectible and indemnity form.; • Naira card issuance fee is N1, 050 (VAT inclusive).; • Dollar Card costs N1,050 or equivalent in Dollar (issuance fee) + annual maintenance fee $10 or equivalent in Naira.; • Courier charge varies with location.; • All documents alongside the form should be sent to nrnaccount@gtbank.com

question: How do I request for proxy pick-up of my card?
answer: • Fill the Account collectible and indemnity form for proxy pick up. • Provide a signed written instruction addressed to the bank which should state your account number and name, the pickup branch you want proxy to visit, the valid means of ID of proxy and the proxy’s name. • All documents alongside the form should be sent to nrnaccount@gtbank.com

question: How do I request for reference letter?
answer: • Provide a signed written instruction addressed to the bank requesting for a reference letter and indicating the institution you want it addressed to, the pickup branch you want proxy to visit, the valid means of ID of proxy.; • Provide the data page of any of your Nigerian Regulatory issued ID (International passport, driver’s license, national ID etc), or provide your notarized foreign regulatory ID card.; • The reference letter cost N500.; • Send to nrnaccount@gtbank.com OR Visit the Internet Banking platform to apply for a Reference letter and have it sent to your registered email address

question: How do I add a signatory on my account?
answer: • Provide a signed instruction addressed to the bank indicating your account details, name of the new signatory, means of regulatory ID of the new signatory, the signatory mandate (either or both to sign), the branch the signatory will visit (if different from your domicile branch).; • Provide the data page of any of your Nigerian Regulatory issued ID (International passport, driver’s license, national ID etc), or provide your notarized foreign regulatory ID card.; • If additional signatory is not in the country, he/she would fill the mandate form and provide a valid ID.

question: How do I request for my dividend to be paid into my account?

question: How do I report an International dispense error
